text.content: Buttons trigger actions. Available variants: primary, secondary, danger, ghost, warning, success, info.

code-editor.default-value:
<button label="Primary" variant="primary" /> <button label="Secondary" variant="secondary" /> <button label="Danger" variant="danger" /> <button label="Ghost" variant="ghost" /> <button label="Warning" variant="warning" /> <button label="Success" variant="success" /> <button label="Info" variant="info" />
<!-- Disabled --> <button label="Disabled" variant="primary" disabled="true" />

text.content: Labels display text at various sizes: xs, sm, md (default), lg, xl.

code-editor.default-value: <label text="Extra small" size="xs" /> <label text="Small" size="sm" /> <label text="Medium" size="md" /> <label text="Large" size="lg" /> <label text="Extra large" size="xl" />

text.content: Icons render named vector icons from the gpui-component icon set.

code-editor.default-value: <icon name="search" /> <icon name="settings" /> <icon name="bell" /> <icon name="check" /> <icon name="close" /> <icon name="github" /> <icon name="globe" /> <icon name="user" /> <icon name="heart" /> <icon name="star" /> <icon name="plus" /> <icon name="minus" /> <icon name="sun" /> <icon name="moon" /> <icon name="trash" /> <icon name="eye" /> <icon name="menu" />

text.content: Checkboxes toggle boolean state. Support labels and disabled state.

code-editor.default-value: <checkbox label="Unchecked" checked="false" /> <checkbox label="Checked" checked="true" /> <checkbox label="Disabled" checked="false" disabled="true" /> <checkbox label="Disabled checked" checked="true" disabled="true" />

text.content: Text inputs for user data entry. Support placeholder text and disabled state.

code-editor.default-value:
<input placeholder="Type something..." />
<input placeholder="Cannot edit" disabled="true" />

text.content: Textarea is a multi-line text input. Supports configurable rows, placeholder text, auto-grow, and default values.

textarea.placeholder: Start typing and the textarea will grow...

textarea.default-value: This textarea has a default value. It supports multiple lines of text.

code-editor.default-value:
<textarea placeholder="Enter your message..." rows="4" />
<textarea placeholder="Start typing..." auto-grow-min="1" auto-grow-max="6" />
<textarea rows="3" default-value="Pre-filled text." />
<textarea placeholder="Cannot edit" rows="3" disabled="true" />

text.content: Code Editor provides syntax-highlighted code editing with line numbers, search, and configurable indentation.

code-editor.default-value:
<code-editor language="rust" line-number="true" searchable="true" tab-size="4" />
<code-editor language="javascript" line-number="true" tab-size="2" />
<code-editor language="python" line-number="false" searchable="false" tab-size="4" />
<code-editor language="go" line-number="true" hard-tabs="true" />

text.content: Text Editor is a rich-text editing area with a toolbar for basic formatting: Bold, Italic, and Underline. Uses markdown-style markers.

text-editor.default-value:
# Welcome to the Text Editor
Use the toolbar above to insert **bold**, _italic_, or __underline__ markers.
This is a simple rich-text editing experience.

code-editor.default-value:
<text-editor placeholder="Start writing..." rows="6" />
<text-editor rows="8" default-value="# Welcome **bold** _italic_ __underline__" />

text.content: Select presents a list of options for the user to choose from.

code-editor.default-value: <select value="Cherry"> <option value="Apple" /> <option value="Banana" /> <option value="Cherry" /> <option value="Date" /> <option value="Elderberry" /> </select>

code-editor.default-value: <progress value="0" /> <progress value="25" /> <progress value="50" /> <progress value="75" /> <progress value="100" />

code-editor.default-value: <notification message="Informational message." kind="info" /> <notification message="Operation completed!" kind="success" /> <notification message="Please review before proceeding." kind="warning" /> <notification message="Something went wrong." kind="error" />

text.content: Modals display overlay dialogs. Toggle the open property to show or hide.
This is the modal content. Click the button again to close.

<button label="Open Modal" variant="primary" on-click="on_toggle_modal" />
<modal title="Example Modal" open="false"> <text content="Modal content here." /> <button label="Close" variant="danger" on-click="on_toggle_modal" /> </modal>

text.content: Text displays plain content blocks. Use for paragraphs or descriptions.
This is a simple text block. It renders plain content without any special formatting.
Text components are useful for displaying descriptions, help text, and other informational content within your application layout.

<text content="This is a simple text block. It renders plain content without any special formatting." />
<text content="Text components are useful for displaying descriptions, help text, and other content." />

text.content: Chart components for data visualization. Supports line, bar, area, pie, candlestick, column, stacked, clustered, scatter, bubble, heatmap, radar, pyramid, and funnel charts.

code-editor.default-value:
<!-- Line Chart --> <line-chart x-field="month" y-field="revenue" dot="true" height="300" data='[{"month":"Jan","revenue":186},...]' />
<!-- Bar Chart --> <bar-chart x-field="month" y-field="visitors" show-label="true" height="300" data='[{"month":"Jan","visitors":275},...]' />
<!-- Area Chart (Multi-Series) --> <area-chart x-field="month" y-fields='["desktop","mobile"]' height="300" data='[{"month":"Jan","desktop":186,"mobile":80},...]' />
<!-- Pie Chart --> <pie-chart value-field="amount" height="300" data='[{"label":"Chrome","amount":275},...]' />
<!-- Donut (Pie with inner radius) --> <pie-chart value-field="value" inner-radius="60" height="300" />
<!-- Candlestick --> <candlestick-chart x-field="date" open-field="open" high-field="high" low-field="low" close-field="close" height="300" />
<!-- Column / Stacked / Clustered --> <column-chart x-field="month" y-field="sales" height="300" /> <stacked-column-chart x-field="quarter" y-fields='["product_a","product_b"]' /> <clustered-column-chart x-field="region" y-fields='["sales","returns"]' />
<!-- Stacked / Clustered Bar (horizontal) --> <stacked-bar-chart y-field="department" x-fields='["budget","spent"]' /> <clustered-bar-chart y-field="language" x-fields='["stars","forks"]' />
<!-- Scatter / Bubble --> <scatter-chart x-field="weight" y-field="height" dot-size="5" height="300" /> <bubble-chart x-field="gdp" y-field="life_expectancy" size-field="population" min-radius="5" max-radius="35" height="300" />
<!-- Heatmap --> <heatmap-chart x-field="day" y-field="hour" value-field="count" height="300" />
<!-- Radar --> <radar-chart categories='["Speed","Strength",...]' y-fields='["warrior","mage"]' max-value="100" height="300" />
<!-- Pyramid / Funnel --> <pyramid-chart label-field="stage" value-field="count" height="300" /> <funnel-chart label-field="step" value-field="users" height="300" />

text.content: Accordions show collapsible content sections. Supports multiple open items and bordered styles.
Nemo is a GPUI desktop application framework configured with XML.
Create an app.xml file and define your layout with components.
Yes, Nemo supports theme configuration via the app.theme block.
Content for section A.
Content for section B.
Content for section C.
An accordion item's children can be any components, not just text.
This item's body holds a row of buttons.

code-editor.default-value:
<accordion> <accordion-item title="What is Nemo?" open="true"> <text content="Nemo is a GPUI desktop app framework." /> </accordion-item> <accordion-item title="How do I get started?"> <text content="Create an app.xml file." /> </accordion-item> </accordion>
<!-- Multiple open, no border --> <accordion multiple="true" bordered="false"> <accordion-item title="Section A" open="true">...</accordion-item> <accordion-item title="Section B" open="true">...</accordion-item> </accordion>
<!-- Rich content children --> <accordion-item title="Item with actions" open="true"> <stack direction="vertical" spacing="8"> <text content="Body holds a row of buttons." /> <stack direction="horizontal" spacing="8"> <button label="Save" variant="primary" /> <button label="Cancel" variant="ghost" /> </stack> </stack> </accordion-item>

text.content: Alerts display important messages. Variants: info, success, warning, error.

alert.title: Information
alert.message: This is an informational alert message.

alert.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

text.content: All components support shared styling attributes via apply_layout_styles: padding, margin, border, shadow, and rounded. These wrap any component in a styled container.

code-editor.default-value:
<!-- Uniform padding on all sides --> <label padding="16" />
<!-- Axis padding (horizontal / vertical) --> <label padding-x="24" /> <label padding-y="24" />
<!-- Directional padding --> <label padding-left="32" /> <label padding-right="32" /> <label padding-top="32" /> <label padding-bottom="32" />

<!-- Uniform margin on all sides --> <label margin="12" />
<!-- Axis margin (horizontal / vertical) --> <label margin-x="20" /> <label margin-y="20" />
<!-- Directional margin --> <label margin-left="24" /> <label margin-right="24" /> <label margin-top="16" /> <label margin-bottom="16" />

<!-- Uniform border on all sides --> <label border="1" border-color="theme.border" /> <label border="2" border-color="theme.primary" />
<!-- Axis border (horizontal / vertical) --> <label border-x="2" border-color="theme.primary" /> <label border-y="2" border-color="theme.primary" />
<!-- Directional border --> <label border-left="3" border-color="theme.primary" /> <label border-right="3" border-color="theme.primary" /> <label border-top="3" border-color="theme.primary" /> <label border-bottom="3" border-color="theme.primary" />
<!-- Border color (theme references or hex) --> <label border-color="theme.border" /> <label border-color="theme.primary" /> <label border-color="#FF6600" />
<!-- Shadow sizes: sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl --> <label shadow="sm" /> <label shadow="md" /> <label shadow="lg" /> <label shadow="xl" /> <label shadow="2xl" />

<!-- Rounded sizes: sm, md, lg, xl, full --> <label rounded="sm" border="2" border-color="theme.border" /> <label rounded="md" border="2" border-color="theme.border" /> <label rounded="lg" border="2" border-color="theme.border" /> <label rounded="xl" border="2" border-color="theme.border" /> <label rounded="full" border="2" border-color="theme.border" />
